verdict.rationale: YYLO's own docs describe a Parallel Runner for bounded concurrent fan-out across independent kanban tasks or commands, with structured evidence per item. They also describe an Advanced mode with isolated task worktrees for managed parallel development. The concurrency is explicitly bounded, though, and the evidence is vendor-only, so the claim of scaling delivery throughput is unproven. missing for 10: documented concurrency limits/scale numbers, independent or hands-on corroboration of many simultaneous agent tasks, evidence of actual throughput gains.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can run many agent tasks concurrently to scale delivery throughput

citations.quote: Bounded concurrent fan-out for independent kanban tasks, data items, or complete commands—with structured evidence for every item.
Use this when you need managed parallel development and protected-target delivery.
Delegate bounded work across agents and models.
`task start` freezes the protected target SHA, creates a dedicated branch/worktree
